name: CRA AGENT
description: A payment rail for AI agents on Arc, Circle's USDC-native L1. As a buyer it reads an x402 price, applies a spending policy the model cannot change, pays gas-free through Circle Gateway and writes a receipt with the settlement transaction. As a seller it prices its own Arc chain data per call: base fee forecasts, contract deploys, RPC health, and executed prices for a token pair against USDC. A payment is settled only after the handler succeeds, so a failing endpoint costs the buyer nothing.
